summary.name: Mastodon.social
summary.one_liner: Mastodon.social is the original server of the Mastodon decentralized microblogging network, operated by Mastodon GmbH.
use_cases: find an alternative to centralized social media
post short updates to the fediverse
follow people on other Mastodon servers
summary.what_it_does: The page describes mastodon.social as the original server of Mastodon, operated by Mastodon GmbH for the common good. Mastodon is described in the listing as a self-hosted, globally interconnected microblogging community. The page text itself is mostly a set of user posts about a leaked ICE/DHS worker data archive and Bluesky blocking links to it, not product documentation. Apart from the listing's note that Mastodon is freeware and open-source (linking to the GitHub repository), no features, pricing or platform details are stated on the page.
notable: Original server of the Mastodon project, run by Mastodon GmbH
Part of a federated network where servers interconnect
Mastodon software is open source on GitHub
caveats: Page text is mostly unrelated user posts, with few product facts
Platform list and feature details are not stated on the page
